note: each cell uses its shape family with n_clips replaced by the cell's length

screen.rule: per shape (in dataset order s = 0..5): the 10-clip test scenes, lowest scene ID first within each variant, cycling over variants from variant s mod 4; 5 per shape

calibration_r1.rule: for every shape and n_clips in [5, 10]: validation scene of rank 0 (by scene ID) within each variant; one per variant, 4 per shape and length

calibration_r2.rule: for every shape and n_clips in [5, 10]: validation scene of rank 1 (by scene ID) within each variant; one per variant, 4 per shape and length
